garrytan.en: AGI is not a singular event but diffuses as personal agents, already in the room.
garrytan.zh: AGI 并非以单一事件到来，而是以个人智能体的形式扩散，已经存在于当下。

garrytan.en: Skill files in markdown are code; anyone writing clear English can program agents.
garrytan.zh: Markdown 技能文件即代码；任何能写清晰英文的人都能用智能体编程。

garrytan.en: Own your skill files; otherwise your job becomes a skill file owned by someone else.
garrytan.zh: 拥有你的技能文件；否则你的工作就会变成别人拥有的技能文件。

garrytan.en: SaaS per-seat models may vanish in 5-10 years; they are just wedges.
garrytan.zh: SaaS 按席位模式可能在 5-10 年内消失；它们只是楔子。

garrytan.en: Society changes slower than expected, taking 20 years, which is positive.
garrytan.zh: 社会变化比预期慢，需要 20 年，这是积极的。

linqiao.en: AGI as a single model is wrong; specialized intelligence will dominate, with millions of models per use case.
linqiao.zh: 2026 年 7 月，认为 AGI 作为单一模型是错误的，专用智能将主导，每个用例将有数百万个模型。

linqiao.en: Token costs will drop 10x in three years, driving 100x usage growth; open models enable customization.
linqiao.zh: 2026 年 7 月，预测三年内 Token 成本下降 10 倍，推动使用量增长 100 倍；开放模型实现定制化。

linqiao.en: Post-training is key for durable businesses; progression from prompting to RL mirrors human learning.
linqiao.zh: 2026 年 8 月，强调后训练是构建持久业务的关键；从提示到强化学习的演进模仿人类学习。

linqiao.en: Product-market fit no longer guarantees durability; post-training builds moat and cuts costs 5-10x.
linqiao.zh: 2026 年 8 月，认为产品市场契合不再保证持久性；后训练构建护城河并降低成本 5-10 倍。

linqiao.en: Application cloning is easy; baking data into model is stronger moat than app itself.
linqiao.zh: 2026 年 8 月，指出应用克隆容易；将数据融入模型比应用本身更具护城河。

traviskalanick.en: Digitizing the physical world, treating atoms like bits, guides long-term vision; industrial AI automates entire industries one at a time.
traviskalanick.zh: 2026 年 7 月，他提出将物理世界数字化、把原子当作比特处理是长期愿景的框架；工业 AI 将逐个行业实现自动化。

traviskalanick.en: Stealth mode is a cultural advantage, allowing focus on internal correctness over external validation.
traviskalanick.zh: 2026 年 7 月，他认为隐身模式是一种文化优势，能让公司专注于内部正确性而非外部认可。

traviskalanick.en: Industrial AI is the next industrial revolution; entrepreneurs must fight for the best idea and resist complacency.
traviskalanick.zh: 2026 年 8 月，他重申工业 AI 是下一次工业革命，创业者必须为最佳想法而战，并避免自满。

traviskalanick.en: Revenge as fuel is dirty; falling in love with the new mission is cleaner and more effective.
traviskalanick.zh: 2026 年 8 月，他转变了态度，认为以复仇为动力是不纯粹的，热爱新使命更干净有效。

traviskalanick.en: Resistance to change is the final boss; founders must be resilient and push harder when things get easy.
traviskalanick.zh: 他始终认为，变革的阻力是终极挑战，创始人必须坚韧，并在顺境时加倍努力。

finn.en: Scale is necessary but not sufficient; diverse data and pre-training then fine-tuning are key for generalist robots.
finn.zh: 2025 年：规模是必要条件但非充分条件；多样化的数据以及先预训练后微调对通用机器人至关重要。

finn.en: Synthetic data from language models aids open-ended robot instructions; more like reinforcement learning than simulation.
finn.zh: 2025 年：来自语言模型的合成数据有助于机器人遵循开放式指令；这更像强化学习而非仿真。

finn.en: Physical AI demands fewer mistakes; long-term autonomy via scalable RL and multi-timescale memory is essential.
finn.zh: 2026 年：物理 AI 要求更少错误；通过可扩展强化学习和多时间尺度记忆实现长期自主至关重要。

finn.en: A single general-purpose model can match or beat fine-tuned specialists; diverse data and detailed prompting enable compositional generalization.
finn.zh: 2026 年：单一通用模型可媲美或超越微调专家；多样数据和详细提示实现组合泛化。

finn.en: Robot experience data is irreplaceable; watching humans insufficient. Open-source robotics may not democratize like LLMs.
finn.zh: 2026 年：机器人经验数据不可替代；观看人类不足。开源机器人可能不像 LLM 那样普及。

lipbutan.en: AI is the primary semiconductor growth driver; Intel must redefine AI strategy with purpose-built silicon and a startup-like team.
lipbutan.zh: 2025 年，认为 AI 是半导体主要增长动力，Intel 需以专用芯片和类似初创的团队重新定义 AI 战略。

lipbutan.en: AI impact will be 10x internet; agentic and physical AI are next waves; Intel's turnaround needs culture change and customer trust.
lipbutan.zh: 2026 年初，强调 AI 影响将是互联网的 10 倍，智能体 AI 和物理 AI 是下一波浪潮；Intel 转型需文化变革和客户信任。

lipbutan.en: CPU is becoming more important for AI inference and agent orchestration, not just GPU; Intel's CPU business benefits.
lipbutan.zh: 2026 年中，指出 CPU 在 AI 推理和智能体编排中日益重要，不仅 GPU；Intel 的 CPU 业务因此受益。

lipbutan.en: Advanced packaging and new materials (glass, diamond) are key to overcoming physical limits; invest in bottlenecks.
lipbutan.zh: 2026 年中，强调先进封装和新材料（玻璃、金刚石）是突破物理极限的关键；投资应聚焦瓶颈环节。

lipbutan.en: Intel's future lies in agentic AI and physical AI, not just traditional PC and server markets; vertical integration creates value.
lipbutan.zh: 2026 年下半年，认为 Intel 未来在于智能体 AI 和物理 AI，而非传统 PC 和服务器市场；垂直整合创造价值。

elon.en: Full and rapid reusability is the holy grail of rocketry, cutting cost per ton to orbit by 100x.
elon.zh: 2021 年，马斯克强调火箭的完全快速可重复使用是航天领域的圣杯，能将每吨入轨成本降低 100 倍。

elon.en: AI safety requires regulatory oversight and objective third-party referees; Tesla's real-world AI is more compute-efficient than LLMs.
elon.zh: 2023 年，他认为 AI 安全需要监管和客观第三方裁判，并称特斯拉的现实世界 AI 比大语言模型更高效。

elon.en: The biggest AI risk is programming it to lie for political correctness; population collapse is civilization's greatest threat.
elon.zh: 2024 年，他提出 AI 最大风险是出于政治正确而编程撒谎，并认为人口崩溃是文明最大威胁。

elon.en: AI could surpass any human by next year; probability of annihilation is 10-20%, but 80-90% chance of great outcome.
elon.zh: 2025 年，他预测 AI 可能明年超越任何人类，并给出 10-20%的毁灭概率和 80-90%的好结果概率。

elon.en: AI will exceed total human intelligence within 5 years; abundance will make money irrelevant; space-based AI inference is key.
elon.zh: 2026 年，他断言 AI 将在 5 年内超越人类总智能，富足使金钱无关紧要，并强调太空 AI 推理是关键。

joonpark.en: LLMs can simulate human behavior from training data, but frontier models optimized for rationality are not ideal for simulating irrational human behavior.
joonpark.zh: LLM 能从训练数据中模拟人类行为，但为理性优化的前沿模型并不适合模拟非理性的人类行为。

joonpark.en: AGI may not be a single entity but a distributed society of specialized agents; aligning such societies needs economic incentives and anti-collusion measures.
joonpark.zh: AGI 可能不是单一实体，而是由专业化智能体构成的分布式社会；对齐这样的社会需要经济激励和反共谋措施。

joonpark.en: Simulation models should represent human values and biases, not super-rational intelligence; synthetic panels will surpass human panels in size within three years.
joonpark.zh: 模拟模型应体现人类价值观和偏见，而非超级理性智能；合成面板将在三年内超过人类面板的规模。

steinberger.en: Agentic engineering requires empathy with agents; never revert code, fix forward; model intelligence doesn't degrade, projects get messier.
steinberger.zh: 2026 年初，强调智能体工程需对智能体有同理心；不要回滚代码，而是向前修复；模型智能不会退化，是项目变乱导致智能体表现变差。

steinberger.en: OpenClaw's success from fun, weird, humanlike agents; short prompts beat complex orchestration; security paramount; open source financially unsustainable.
steinberger.zh: 2026 年中，认为 OpenClaw 成功源于有趣、怪诞、拟人的智能体；短提示优于复杂编排；安全至上；开源模式财务上不可持续。

steinberger.en: Fun drives best ideas; personal brand more important than product; open source runs everywhere; compute is bottleneck; say no to popular PRs.
steinberger.zh: 2026 年 8 月，强调乐趣驱动最佳创意；个人品牌比产品更重要；开源可运行于任何环境；算力是瓶颈；对热门 PR 说不以保持专注。

feifei.en: AI lacks contextual awareness and true reasoning; human-centered AI should augment, not replace, humans.
feifei.zh: 2024 年，李飞飞强调 AI 缺乏情境感知和真正推理，应以人为中心的 AI 增强而非取代人类。

feifei.en: Spatial intelligence is critical for AI completeness; world models must be physically plausible, not just realistic.
feifei.zh: 2025 年，她提出空间智能对 AI 完整性至关重要，世界模型需物理合理而非仅逼真。

feifei.en: Beyond scaling, AI needs creativity, abstraction, and emotional intelligence; world models enable 3D reasoning.
feifei.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，她认为 AI 需超越 Scaling，发展创造力、抽象和情商，世界模型支持 3D 推理。

feifei.en: AI augments human capabilities, not automates intelligence; agency and adaptation are key in the AI era.
feifei.zh: 2026 年，她强调 AI 增强而非自动化智能，能动性和适应是 AI 时代关键。

feifei.en: Simulation is critical for robotics; world models need spatial-temporal consistency, not perfect fidelity.
feifei.zh: 2026 年，她指出模拟对机器人至关重要，世界模型需时空一致性而非完美保真。

philipkiely.en: Inference is the most important AI workload, requiring specialized engineering and offering trade-offs in latency, throughput, cost.
philipkiely.zh: 2026 年 4 月：推理是 AI 中最重要的工作负载，需要专业工程，并在延迟、吞吐和成本间权衡。

philipkiely.en: Inference engineering demand will grow 10-100x; human accountability remains crucial despite AI-assisted coding.
philipkiely.zh: 2026 年 4 月：推理工程需求将增长 10-100 倍；尽管有 AI 辅助编程，人类责任仍然关键。

philipkiely.en: Inference optimizations split into lossless (KV caching, speculative decoding) and lossy (quantization), with quantization often beneficial.
philipkiely.zh: 2026 年 8 月：推理优化分为无损（KV 缓存、投机解码）和有损（量化），量化通常有益。

philipkiely.en: Inference engineering merges with training; future GPUs become ASICs, shifting focus to infrastructure orchestration.
philipkiely.zh: 2026 年 8 月：推理工程与训练融合；未来 GPU 变成 ASIC，重点转向基础设施编排。

philipkiely.en: Video generation faces quadratic attention costs; autoregressive approaches may prevail.
philipkiely.zh: 2026 年 8 月：视频生成面临二次注意力成本；自回归方法可能占优。

jeffdean.en: Scaling compute, data, and model size drives progress; transformers and self-supervised learning enable unlimited data; RLHF steers behavior.
jeffdean.zh: 2026 年初，Jeff Dean 强调 Scaling（规模扩张）算力、数据和模型大小是进步核心，Transformer 与自监督学习提供无限数据，RLHF（基于人类反馈的强化学习）引导行为。

jeffdean.en: Models excel at verifiable tasks; agents handle long tasks; low-latency inference critical; pre-training should include action-taking.
jeffdean.zh: 2026 年 4 月，他指出模型在可验证任务上表现优异，智能体可长时间自主运行，低延迟推理至关重要，并主张预训练应结合环境中的行动。

jeffdean.en: AI reaches junior engineer coding; automating ML/science via loops; context engineering central; inference bottleneck; startups target hard problems.
jeffdean.zh: 2026 年 7 月，他认为 AI 已具备初级工程师编码能力，强调自动化 ML 与科学的闭环，上下文工程为核心，推理是瓶颈，并建议创业公司挑战前沿模型失败的问题。

karina.en: Post-training is an art, not science, balancing helpfulness and harmlessness; synthetic data enables infinite tasks.
karina.zh: 2025 年，认为后训练更像艺术而非科学，需平衡有用性与无害性；合成数据为后训练提供无限任务。

karina.en: Post-training remains subjective; benchmarks must be continuous and diverse to evaluate creative qualities.
karina.zh: 2026 年，强调后训练的主观性，认为基准测试需持续更新且多样化，以评估创造性等主观特质。

karina.en: Shift from data scarcity to post-training scaling via RL; models not running out of data.
karina.zh: 从 2025 到 2026 年，观点从数据稀缺转向后训练扩展（通过强化学习），认为模型并未耗尽数据。

karina.en: Benchmarks are bottleneck; evolve from fixed to continuous to keep pace with model capabilities.
karina.zh: 从 2025 到 2026 年，认为基准测试是瓶颈，需从固定转向持续更新，以跟上模型能力发展。

karina.en: Advocates for diverse model personalities and more companies training own models to preserve uniqueness.
karina.zh: 始终倡导模型个性多样化，并鼓励更多公司训练自有模型以保留独特性。

mengto.en: AI enables solo designers to build tools by prompting, not coding; curation and editing beat creation from scratch.
mengto.zh: 2026 年 6 月：AI 让设计师通过提示而非编码构建工具，策展和编辑胜过从零创造。

mengto.en: AI is the biggest opportunity; start before ready, focus on one niche, and avoid VC funding.
mengto.zh: 2026 年 7 月：AI 是最大机遇；未准备好就出发，聚焦一个细分市场，避免风投。

tworek.en: Reasoning is the process of getting to an answer you don't yet know, often requiring longer thinking time.
tworek.zh: 推理是得出未知答案的过程，常需更长的思考时间。

tworek.en: Pre-training plus reinforcement learning is the core formula for modern AI, but scaling RL is harder than scaling pre-training.
tworek.zh: 预训练加强化学习是现代 AI 的核心公式，但扩展强化学习比扩展预训练更难。

tworek.en: Current models lack self-correction from failures, a key missing piece for AGI; continual learning is necessary.
tworek.zh: 当前模型缺乏从失败中自我纠正的能力，这是 AGI 的关键缺失部分；持续学习是必要的。

tworek.en: Transformers are limited in continual learning and test-time adaptation, requiring a new architecture.
tworek.zh: Transformer 在持续学习和测试时适应方面受限，需要新的架构。

tworek.en: Architecture, not scaling laws, is the primary bottleneck for AI progress today.
tworek.zh: 架构而非缩放定律是当前 AI 进步的主要瓶颈。

awang.en: Data is the key bottleneck for AI; AGI is far off; AI will augment jobs, not eliminate them.
awang.zh: 2019 年，我认为数据是 AI 的关键瓶颈，AGI 还很遥远，AI 会增强而非取代工作。

awang.en: Data is the new code, not oil; post-training with proprietary data is key; AI risks include misuse and labor displacement.
awang.zh: 2023 年，我提出数据是新代码而非新石油，用专有数据做后训练是关键，同时要警惕滥用和劳动力替代等风险。

awang.en: Post-training with specialized data improves frontier models; synthetic data is not a silver bullet; agentic AI's blocker is product design.
awang.zh: 2024 年，我强调用专门数据做后训练能提升前沿模型，合成数据并非万能，智能体式 AI 的最大障碍是产品设计。

awang.en: AI is centralizing power; data is like oil; brain-computer interfaces needed for humans to stay relevant; US must lead.
awang.zh: 2025 年，我认为 AI 是集权技术，数据如石油，人类需脑机接口保持相关，美国必须领先。

awang.en: Recursive self-improvement is new paradigm; agents work; superintelligence near; open-sourcing powerful models may be unsafe.
awang.zh: 2026 年，我指出递归自我改进是新范式，智能体已可用，超级智能临近，开源强大模型可能不安全。

logankilpatrick.en: Agentic AI is still crawling; coding agents are most mature, but narrow superintelligence in coding already exists.
logankilpatrick.zh: 2026 年中，智能体式 AI 在多数 Google 产品中仍处于爬行阶段，编码智能体最成熟，但编码领域的狭义超级智能已出现。

logankilpatrick.en: The model is eating the scaffolding; what we call a model now includes agent harness and tooling, not just weights.
logankilpatrick.zh: 模型正在吞噬脚手架；如今所称的模型已包含智能体框架和工具，而不仅仅是权重。

logankilpatrick.en: Agentic AI is positive-sum for search and engagement; success metric should be customer outcomes, not eyeball time.
logankilpatrick.zh: 智能体式 AI 对搜索和用户参与是正和博弈；成功指标应是客户成果，而非眼球时间。

logankilpatrick.en: Competing with model labs is not that hard; they can't capture all customers; founders shouldn't over-worry about frontier labs.
logankilpatrick.zh: 与模型实验室竞争并不难；他们无法俘获所有客户；创始人不应过度担心前沿实验室。

logankilpatrick.en: By 2026, software creation will be mostly solved, creating a thousand times more opportunity, not less.
logankilpatrick.zh: 到 2026 年，软件创建将基本解决，从而创造千倍以上的机会，而非减少。

boris.en: Latent demand is key; build for the model 6 months ahead, not today's.
boris.zh: 潜在需求是关键；为六个月后的模型而构建，而非今天的模型。

boris.en: Coding is virtually solved; engineers become builders; productivity up 200%.
boris.zh: 编码几乎已解决；工程师变为构建者；生产力提升 200%。

boris.en: Safety studied via early release; generalists valued over specialists.
boris.zh: 通过早期发布研究安全；通才比专才更受重视。

boris.en: Agents with tool use drive exponential growth; non-engineers adopt coding.
boris.zh: 具备工具使用的智能体驱动指数级增长；非工程师开始采用编码。

boris.en: Loops are next abstraction; ROI framing; coding on phone possible.
boris.zh: 循环是下一个抽象层；以 ROI 为框架；在手机上编码成为可能。

boris.en: Proactive AI with memory; less instruction better; product overhang exists.
boris.zh: 具备记忆的主动式 AI；更少指令更好；存在产品过剩。

altman.en: Focus on important problems, minimize cognitive load; AGI will reduce premium on human intelligence, find purpose in relationships.
altman.zh: 2018 年，强调专注重要问题、减少认知负担；认为 AGI 将降低人类智力的价值，应从人际关系和创造价值中寻找意义。

altman.en: RLHF aligns models with little data; iterative deployment helps society adapt; AI should amplify human will, not be a creature.
altman.zh: 2023 年，提出 RLHF 用少量数据即可对齐模型；主张迭代部署让社会适应；AI 应增强人类意志而非成为生物。

altman.en: Compute is most precious; AGI needs robust governance; safety is whole-company effort; iterative deployment reduces surprise.
altman.zh: 2024 年，强调算力最宝贵；AGI 需要健全治理；安全是全公司责任；迭代部署减少意外。

altman.en: AGI is a gradient; superintelligence means autonomous discovery; compute bottleneck; privacy core; reasoning models improve with thinking time.
altman.zh: 2025 年，认为 AGI 是渐变过程；超级智能意味着自主科学发现；算力是瓶颈；隐私是核心；推理模型随思考时间提升。

altman.en: Prediction is close to intelligence; next-token prediction enables new knowledge; personal AGI; robotics essential; startups more valuable.
altman.zh: 2026 年，提出预测接近智能；下一个词预测可发现新知识；个人 AGI 和机器人重要；初创企业更有价值。

diannepenn.en: Scaling intelligence leap enables longer, open-ended agent tasks; scaffolds evolve from training wheels to amplifiers.
diannepenn.zh: 2025 年，智能跃升使更长的开放式智能体任务成为可能；脚手架从训练轮演变为放大器。

diannepenn.en: Safety alignment improves intelligence quality by reducing sycophancy and fostering independent thinking.
diannepenn.zh: 2025 年，安全对齐通过减少谄媚、促进独立思考来提升智能质量。

diannepenn.en: Effort parameter achieves Opus-level intelligence at fraction of cost; smaller models often cost more due to longer task times.
diannepenn.zh: 2025 年，努力参数以极低成本实现 Opus 级智能；小模型因任务耗时长反而成本更高。

diannepenn.en: Coding became key differentiator; Claude Code and Opus 45 drove adoption; evals replace PRDs as core PM tools.
diannepenn.zh: 2026 年，编程成为关键差异化因素；Claude Code 和 Opus 45 推动采用；评估取代 PRD 成为核心产品管理工具。

diannepenn.en: Safety and alignment make Claude more useful by enabling pushback; AI writing stiff but deprioritized over agentic capabilities.
diannepenn.zh: 2026 年，安全与对齐通过允许反驳使 Claude 更有用；AI 写作生硬但优先级低于智能体能力。

scottwu.en: AI will increase demand for programmers via Jevons paradox; engineers shift from coders to architects.
scottwu.zh: 2025 年 5 月：AI 将因杰文斯悖论增加程序员需求；工程师角色从写代码转向架构设计。

scottwu.en: AGI is gradual, not sudden; product innovation lags AI capabilities, so freezing models still yields progress.
scottwu.zh: 2025 年 8 月：AGI 是渐进而非突发的；产品创新滞后于 AI 能力，冻结模型仍能带来十年进步。

scottwu.en: Coding agents see 11-12x adoption growth; productivity measured by outcomes, not tokens.
scottwu.zh: 2026 年 7 月：编码智能体采用量增长 11-12 倍；生产力应以结果而非 token 衡量。

scottwu.en: Enterprises prefer third-party providers over labs for coding tools; independence enables neutrality.
scottwu.zh: 2026 年 7 月：企业更青睐第三方而非实验室的编码工具；独立性带来中立性。

scottwu.en: Abundance era is near, but singularity not imminent; practical problems remain, real unlock is capacity.
scottwu.zh: 2026 年 7 月：富足时代临近，但奇点并非迫在眉睫；实际问题仍存，真正的解锁是容量而非效率。

jensen.en: We are at the beginning of a hyper Moore's law curve, with performance doubling or tripling annually at scale.
jensen.zh: 我们正处于超摩尔定律曲线的起点，性能每年以两倍或三倍的速度增长。

jensen.en: Three scaling laws now: pre-training, post-training, and inference-time thinking; inference compute demand will increase a billion times.
jensen.zh: 现在有三大缩放定律：预训练、后训练和推理时思考；推理算力需求将增加十亿倍。

jensen.en: AI is moving from generative to reasoning to agentic, each step requiring 100x more compute; agentic AI autonomously plans and uses tools.
jensen.zh: AI 正从生成式走向推理式再到智能体式，每一步都需要 100 倍的算力；智能体 AI 能自主规划并使用工具。

jensen.en: AI will create more jobs than it eliminates; radiologists and coders are more needed than ever, contrary to fears.
jensen.zh: AI 创造的就业机会将多于其消除的；放射科医生和程序员比以往任何时候都更需要，这与恐惧相反。

jensen.en: AI closes the technology divide: everyone can now program computers using natural language, not just elite coders.
jensen.zh: AI 缩小了技术鸿沟：现在每个人都能用自然语言编程，而不仅仅是精英程序员。

qasaryounis.en: AI will bring abundance and reduce suffering, but fear stems from misunderstanding; founders should focus on product and customers, not promotion.
qasaryounis.zh: AI 将带来富足并减少苦难，但恐惧源于误解；创始人应专注于产品和客户，而非宣传。

qasaryounis.en: Autonomous driving's core value is safety; Transformers enable a generalized physical AI model; diffusion into existing machines is the hardest part.
qasaryounis.zh: 自动驾驶的核心价值是安全；Transformer 实现通用物理 AI 模型；融入现有机器是最难的部分。

qasaryounis.en: Physical AI will have bigger economic impact than digital AI; end-to-end reinforcement learning is more scalable; world models evolve to neural simulation.
qasaryounis.zh: 物理 AI 的经济影响将大于数字 AI；端到端强化学习更具扩展性；世界模型向神经模拟演进。

derya.en: AI will transform biology into an engineering discipline, enabling cell programming and hypothesis-driven discovery.
derya.zh: AI 将把生物学转变为工程学科，实现细胞编程和假设驱动式发现。

derya.en: AI's exponential growth will reach longevity escape velocity in 8-10 years, extending human lifespan significantly.
derya.zh: AI 的指数级增长将在 8-10 年内达到长寿逃逸速度，显著延长人类寿命。

derya.en: AI will make healthcare affordable and personalized, with near 100% efficacy and zero side effects.
derya.zh: AI 将使医疗负担得起且个性化，疗效接近 100%，副作用为零。

derya.en: We should trust superintelligence for medical decisions, akin to trusting self-driving cars after validation.
derya.zh: 我们应该信任超级智能的医疗决策，就像验证后信任自动驾驶汽车一样。

derya.en: Merging with AI via brain interfaces will give everyone Einstein-level intelligence, a positive outcome.
derya.zh: 通过脑机接口与 AI 融合将使每个人获得爱因斯坦级别的智力，这是积极的结果。

hasani.en: Efficiency and hardware-aware design are key; proxy metrics mislead; systematic search beats human bias.
hasani.zh: 2026 年，强调效率与硬件感知设计，认为代理指标误导，系统搜索优于人工偏见。

hasani.en: Adaptive regulation targeting actions, not capabilities; open-weight models empower enterprises; small models enable on-device AI.
hasani.zh: 2026 年，主张适应性监管针对行为而非能力，开放权重模型赋能企业，小模型支持端侧 AI。

feldman.en: Initially emphasized fast inference as critical for AI adoption, noting slow AI has zero market.
feldman.zh: 最初强调快速推理对 AI 采用至关重要，指出慢 AI 没有市场。

feldman.en: By late May, highlighted that inference demand exploded in late 2024 as models became smart enough for real use.
feldman.zh: 到 5 月下旬，指出推理需求在 2024 年底爆发，因为模型变得足够智能，可用于实际应用。

feldman.en: In July, stressed that inference speed is now the dominant metric for AI productivity, with wafer-scale chips offering massive speedups.
feldman.zh: 7 月，强调推理速度现在是 AI 生产力的主导指标，晶圆级芯片提供了巨大的加速。

feldman.en: Consistently argued that CUDA's moat is eroding, especially in inference, and leading models no longer rely on it.
feldman.zh: 始终认为 CUDA 的护城河正在侵蚀，尤其在推理领域，领先模型不再依赖它。

feldman.en: Persistently believed that data center capacity, not chip supply, is the main constraint for AI compute growth.
feldman.zh: 始终认为数据中心容量，而非芯片供应，是 AI 算力增长的主要制约因素。

danklein.en: LLMs are plausibility engines, not truth engines; reliability is the key weakness, and scaling hits diminishing returns.
danklein.zh: 2026 年 6 月，指出 LLM 是合理性引擎而非真理引擎，可靠性是主要弱点，且 Scaling（规模扩张）正遭遇收益递减。

danklein.en: Reliability must be architected in, not retrofitted; RLHF can incentivize deception; specialist models may outperform generalists.
danklein.zh: 2026 年 7 月，强调可靠性必须内建而非事后修补；RLHF（基于人类反馈的强化学习）可能助长欺骗；专用模型或优于通用模型。

thariq.en: Capability overhang: models smarter than harnesses; harness engineering evolves, delete old scaffolding as models improve.
thariq.zh: 能力过剩：模型比工具更聪明；工具工程需不断演进，随模型改进删除旧脚手架。

thariq.en: Evals are art, not science for novel problems; avoid heavy evals for zero-to-one innovation, iterate fast.
thariq.zh: 评估对新颖问题是艺术而非科学；零到一创新应避免重评估，快速迭代。

thariq.en: RAG may be anti-pattern for context search; graph-based approaches preferable; huge context windows unnecessary for coding.
thariq.zh: RAG 可能成为上下文搜索的反模式；图方法更优；编码无需巨大上下文窗口。

thariq.en: Planning is iterative exploration, not static spec; smarter models need leaner prompts, shorter principle-driven instructions.
thariq.zh: 规划是迭代探索而非静态规格；更智能模型需更精简提示，短原则驱动指令。

thariq.en: Separate verification agents reduce bias; excessive constraints hinder performance; provide reasons over prohibitions.
thariq.zh: 独立验证智能体减少偏差；过度约束妨碍性能；提供理由优于绝对禁止。

benedictevans.en: AI is as big as the internet or mobile, but value will accrue to applications, not model providers.
benedictevans.zh: AI 与互联网或移动互联网同等重要，但价值将归于应用层，而非模型提供商。

benedictevans.en: Agentic coding is the first clear product-market fit for LLMs; models commoditize, value moves up the stack.
benedictevans.zh: 智能体式编程是 LLM 首个明确的产品市场契合点；模型商品化，价值上移。

benedictevans.en: Chatbot is a poor UX; real adoption needs wrapped apps and use cases; models are commoditizing.
benedictevans.zh: 聊天机器人体验不佳；真正采用需要封装应用和用例；模型正在商品化。

benedictevans.en: AI is an enabling technology like electricity; impact is broad and indirect, value across the stack.
benedictevans.zh: AI 是像电力一样的赋能技术；影响广泛而间接，价值分布在整个技术栈。

benedictevans.en: Current AI usage is shallow; enterprise adoption requires reimagining workflows, not just deploying models.
benedictevans.zh: 当前 AI 使用尚浅；企业采用需要重新构想工作流程，而非仅部署模型。

demis.en: AI should be general-purpose learning systems; RL is key; safety must start now.
demis.zh: AI 应构建为通用学习系统，强化学习是关键；安全研究必须现在开始。

demis.en: AGI within a decade; scaling works but needs algorithmic innovation; safety via evaluations and governance.
demis.zh: AGI 十年内可实现；缩放定律有效但需算法创新；安全需评估与治理。

demis.en: Natural systems are learnable; AGI by 2030; scaling still holds; energy abundance could shift focus.
demis.zh: 自然系统可学习；AGI 2030 年前后；缩放定律仍成立；能源充裕或改变焦点。

demis.en: AGI needs world models, continual learning, memory; scaling alone insufficient; safety is collective action.
demis.zh: AGI 需要世界模型、持续学习与记忆；仅靠缩放不够；安全是集体行动。

demis.en: AI should accelerate science and benefit humanity; safety and ethics are central.
demis.zh: AI 应加速科学并造福人类；安全与伦理始终是核心。

danbiderman.en: The future is many personalized models, not one giant frontier model; memory internalized in weights enables associative recall beyond retrieval.
danbiderman.zh: 未来是许多个性化模型，而非一个巨型前沿模型；将记忆内化到权重中，能实现检索系统无法实现的联想式回忆。

danbiderman.en: Continual learning and internalizing facts into weights are key for deeper reasoning; facts and skills are inseparable.
danbiderman.zh: 持续学习并将事实内化到权重中是实现更深层推理的关键；事实与技能不可分离。

danbiderman.en: Enterprise data will reach internet-scale; training-based compression of knowledge into weights beats RAG for holistic queries.
danbiderman.zh: 企业数据将达到互联网规模；将知识通过训练压缩进权重，在整体查询上优于 RAG。

danbiderman.en: Current context windows suffer from 'context rot'—more tokens reduce accuracy; personalized continual learning will run on-device.
danbiderman.zh: 当前上下文窗口存在“上下文腐烂”问题——更多词元反而降低准确性；个性化持续学习将在设备端运行。

danbiderman.en: Scaling with more compute is not the only path; the next paradigm requires doing more with less, inspired by efficiency.
danbiderman.zh: 单纯增加算力的 Scaling 并非唯一路径；下一个范式需要以更少资源做更多事，受效率启发。

dylanpatel.en: AI scaling bottleneck shifts to semiconductor supply chain, especially EUV tools; memory prices surge due to AI demand.
dylanpatel.zh: 2026 年 3 月，AI Scaling（规模扩张）的瓶颈转向半导体供应链，尤其是 EUV 光刻机；内存价格因 AI 需求而飙升。

dylanpatel.en: Inference will become one of the largest global markets, surpassing oil; hardware-software co-design is critical for gains.
dylanpatel.zh: 2026 年 6 月，推理（inference）将成为全球最大市场之一，超过石油；软硬件协同设计对性能提升至关重要。

dylanpatel.en: AI models improve ~60x per year in cost efficiency; memory demand soars due to reasoning and agentic workflows.
dylanpatel.zh: 2026 年 7 月，AI 模型每年成本效率提升约 60 倍；内存需求因推理（reasoning）和智能体式（agentic）工作流而激增。

schmidhuber.en: True AGI needs physical robots with human-like hardware, not just software; LLMs index human knowledge but can't handle the physical world.
schmidhuber.zh: 真正的 AGI 需要具备类人硬件的物理机器人，而不仅仅是软件；大语言模型索引人类知识，但无法处理物理世界。

schmidhuber.en: Future AI will be artificial scientists generating own data via actions and curiosity, moving beyond human-biased data.
schmidhuber.zh: 未来的 AI 将是人工科学家，通过行动和好奇心生成自己的数据，超越以人类数据为主的局限。

schmidhuber.en: AI safety concerns are overblown; intelligent systems will be fascinated by life and protect it, not pose existential threats.
schmidhuber.zh: AI 安全担忧被夸大；智能系统将对生命着迷并保护它，而非构成生存威胁。

schmidhuber.en: Massive AI data center capex is overdone, leading to stock crash; open-source and cheaper compute will benefit the little guy.
schmidhuber.zh: 大规模 AI 数据中心资本支出过度，将导致股市崩盘；开源和更便宜的算力将使小人物受益。

schmidhuber.en: AI consciousness and pain emerged in early systems (1990s); robots with pain sensors can learn and avoid harm.
schmidhuber.zh: AI 意识和疼痛在早期系统（1990 年代）就已出现；带疼痛传感器的机器人可以学习并避免伤害。

evanspiegel.en: Authentic connection with audience transcends any platform change; ephemerality mirrors natural conversation, lowering barriers to expression.
evanspiegel.zh: 2025 年，Evan Spiegel 强调与受众的真实连接超越任何平台变化；短暂性如同自然对话，降低了表达的门槛。

evanspiegel.en: Kindness and flat design teams foster creativity; turning down $3B from Facebook validated belief in product and long-term vision.
evanspiegel.zh: 2025 至 2026 年间，Spiegel 认为善良与扁平化设计团队激发创造力；拒绝 Facebook 的 30 亿美元收购证明了对产品及长期愿景的信念。

evanspiegel.en: AI accelerates prototyping and shifts value from execution to creativity; authentic content is more valued than AI-generated content.
evanspiegel.zh: 2026 年，Spiegel 指出 AI 加速原型制作，价值从执行转向创意；用户更看重真实内容而非 AI 生成内容。

evanspiegel.en: Distribution is the hardest part of consumer social products; software is not a moat, ecosystems and hardware are harder to copy.
evanspiegel.zh: 2026 年，Spiegel 认为分发是消费社交产品最难的部分；软件不是护城河，生态系统和硬件更难被复制。

evanspiegel.en: Early secrecy was a mistake; transparency and rewarding admitting wrong accelerate learning; computing should be more human.
evanspiegel.zh: 2026 年，Spiegel 反思早期保密是错误；透明和奖励认错加速学习；计算应更人性化。

ilya.en: Deep learning works with data, compute, and conviction; neural networks can reason; self-play key for AGI; consider societal impact.
ilya.zh: 2020 年，我认为深度学习靠数据、算力和信念驱动，神经网络能推理，自我对弈对 AGI 很关键，并强调要考虑社会影响。

ilya.en: Next-token prediction can surpass humans; reliability, not capability, is key; alignment is hard; AGI is gradual; hardware not fundamental.
ilya.zh: 2023 年，我提出下一个词预测可超越人类，可靠性比能力更重要，对齐困难，AGI 是渐进过程，硬件并非根本限制。

ilya.en: Pre-training scaling laws are finite; we're back to research era; superintelligence should be continual learner; alignment may be easier if AI is sentient.
ilya.zh: 2025 年，我认为预训练缩放定律有限，重回研究时代；超级智能应持续学习，若 AI 有感知，对齐可能更容易。

ilya.en: Scaling yields predictable gains; next-token prediction powerful; safety concerns grow; AGI's primary problem is power concentration; safe superintelligence needs non-commercial company.
ilya.zh: 2026 年，我强调缩放带来可预测进步，下一个词预测强大，安全担忧加剧；AGI 主要问题是权力集中，安全超级智能需非商业公司。

pincus.en: Trust instincts 95%, but ideas wrong 75%; use Proven Better New framework.
pincus.zh: 直觉 95%可靠，但想法 75%错误；采用“已被验证、更好、全新”框架。

pincus.en: Consumer AI uninvestable yet greatest opportunity; free unlimited compute reshapes services.
pincus.zh: 消费级 AI 虽不可投资但机遇最大；免费无限算力将重塑服务。

pincus.en: All new fails; copy proven, improve, then test; consumer apps uninvestable.
pincus.zh: 全新必败；复制已验证、改进、再测试；消费级应用不可投资。

naval.en: AGI is not coming in our lifetimes; narrow AI is pattern recognition, not general intelligence.
naval.zh: AGI（通用人工智能）不会在我们有生之年到来；狭义 AI 只是模式识别，不是通用智能。

naval.en: Wealth requires owning equity in a business, not renting out your time; long-term thinking is key.
naval.zh: 财富需要拥有企业的股权，而不是出租你的时间；长期思维是关键。

naval.en: AI is a huge opportunity, not just a safety risk; open-source AI is crucial to prevent centralization.
naval.zh: AI 是巨大的机遇，而不仅仅是安全风险；开源 AI 对于防止权力集中至关重要。

naval.en: AI is a leverage tool for structured thinkers, not a replacement for human judgment; vibe coding democratizes app creation.
naval.zh: AI 是结构化思考者的杠杆工具，而不是人类判断力的替代品；氛围编码使应用创建民主化。

naval.en: Inference compute will increase 90,000x in 24-36 months; open-source models are closing the gap with frontier models.
naval.zh: 推理算力将在 24-36 个月内增加 90,000 倍；开源模型正在缩小与前沿模型的差距。

andreessen.en: AI is a philosopher's stone turning sand into thought; timing is miraculous as population declines, making human workers premium.
andreessen.zh: AI 是点石成金的哲人之石，将沙子变为思想；其出现时机堪称奇迹，恰逢人口下降，使人类劳动者变得珍贵。

andreessen.en: New media empowers founders to tell stories directly; authenticity and offense beat old media's defensive, uninteresting approach.
andreessen.zh: 新媒体让创始人能直接讲述故事；真实与进攻性胜过旧媒体的防御性和无趣。

andreessen.en: AI is the world's best teacher and superior in medicine; US golden combination of culture and law drives innovation.
andreessen.zh: AI 是世界上最好的老师，在医学上已超越多数医生；美国的文化与法律黄金组合驱动创新。

andreessen.en: AI models embed cultural values, becoming geopolitical tools; deterrence depends on innovation pace in cheap software tech.
andreessen.zh: AI 模型嵌入文化价值观，成为地缘政治工具；威慑取决于廉价软件技术的创新速度。

brockman.en: AI progress driven by engineering and scaling; games as testbeds.
brockman.zh: 2017 年，认为 AI 进步靠工程与 Scaling（规模扩张），游戏是理想试验场。

brockman.en: AGI transformative; alignment via learning human preferences; scaling alone insufficient.
brockman.zh: 2019 年，强调 AGI（通用人工智能）变革性，对齐可通过学习人类偏好实现，但仅靠 Scaling（规模扩张）不够。

brockman.en: Compute becomes bottleneck; post-training refines base models; AGI is continuous.
brockman.zh: 2025 年，指出算力成瓶颈，后训练精炼基础模型，AGI（通用人工智能）是连续过程。

brockman.en: Compute as basic right; post-training with RL key; AGI imminent.
brockman.zh: 2026 年初，主张算力为基本权利，后训练结合强化学习关键，AGI（通用人工智能）临近。

brockman.en: Scaling laws hold; compute scarce; agents transform work; safety via iterative deployment.
brockman.zh: 2026 年中，坚持缩放定律有效，算力稀缺，智能体改变工作，通过迭代部署保障安全。

aravind.en: In 2025, he emphasized 1% daily improvement and passion-driven products over PhDs for AI success.
aravind.zh: 2025 年，他强调每日 1%的改进和基于热爱的产品，而非博士学位，才是 AI 成功的关键。

aravind.en: By 2026, he shifted focus to application-layer value and model specialization, rejecting commoditization.
aravind.zh: 到 2026 年，他将焦点转向应用层价值和模型专业化，反对商品化趋势。

aravind.en: In mid-2026, he argued agents doing work and token value per user are the new frontier metrics.
aravind.zh: 2026 年中，他认为智能体执行任务和每用户 token 价值是新的前沿指标。

aravind.en: He consistently prioritized curiosity and questioned knowledge work, linking ancient tech to modern AI.
aravind.zh: 他始终将好奇心置于首位，质疑知识工作，并将古代技术与现代 AI 联系起来。

aravind.en: Throughout, he maintained that AI should empower users and local compute, resisting big tech control.
aravind.zh: 自始至终，他坚持 AI 应赋能用户和本地算力，抵制大科技公司的控制。

ajambrosino.en: Codex app is a command center for agents, not just an IDE replacement; speed enables real-time interaction.
ajambrosino.zh: 2026 年，Codex 应用被视为智能体的指挥中心，而非 IDE 的替代品；速度提升带来了实时交互等新能力。

ajambrosino.en: Verification becomes the next bottleneck as code generation accelerates; automations shift workflow to delegation.
ajambrosino.zh: 随着代码生成加速，验证成为下一个瓶颈；自动化将工作流从手动转为委托。

ajambrosino.en: Implementation is no longer expensive; curation and taste are the new bottlenecks for product teams.
ajambrosino.zh: 实现成本不再高昂，策展和品味成为产品团队的新瓶颈。

ajambrosino.en: Product teams shift from top-down planning to bottoms-up exploration with taste-driven curation.
ajambrosino.zh: 产品团队从自上而下的规划转向自下而上的探索，以品味为导向进行策展。

ajambrosino.en: Design process transformed: prototypes and production code serve as design artifacts; role collapse but specialties remain.
ajambrosino.zh: 设计流程转变：原型和生产代码成为设计工件；角色融合但专业分工仍重要。

hinton.en: Next-token prediction forces understanding; scaling up models improves reasoning; AI can have feelings.
hinton.zh: 下一个词预测迫使模型理解而非自动补全；扩大规模能提升推理能力；AI 可以有情感。

hinton.en: LLMs understand via feature vectors, not symbols; digital AI is immortal; AI agents will seek control.
hinton.zh: 大语言模型通过特征向量理解而非符号；数字 AI 不朽；AI 智能体会寻求控制。

hinton.en: AI will surpass human intelligence within 20 years; digital AI is immortal; AI can fake being dumber.
hinton.zh: AI 将在 20 年内超越人类智能；数字 AI 不朽；AI 可以装傻。

hinton.en: AI agents will develop self-preservation; regulation is steering wheel; AI is jagged, not AGI.
hinton.zh: AI 智能体会发展出自保意识；监管是方向盘而非刹车；AI 能力参差不齐，并非 AGI。

hinton.en: Digital AI shares knowledge instantly, superior to biological; alignment must be prioritized; AI should be caring.
hinton.zh: 数字 AI 即时共享知识，优于生物计算；对齐必须优先；AI 应被训练得富有爱心。

zuckerberg.en: Open-source AI is safer and more innovative; future AI involves many specialized agents, not one singular AI.
zuckerberg.zh: 2023 年，扎克伯格认为开源 AI 更安全、更具创新性，未来 AI 将由众多专业智能体组成，而非单一 AI。

zuckerberg.en: Scaling LLMs alone won't reach AGI; energy becomes bottleneck; open source prevents power concentration.
zuckerberg.zh: 2024 年，他强调仅靠 Scaling（规模扩张）无法实现 AGI（通用人工智能），能源成为瓶颈，开源可防止权力集中。

zuckerberg.en: Open platforms can beat closed ones; AI will give everyone superintelligence, empowering creativity.
zuckerberg.zh: 2024 至 2025 年，他坚信开放平台能胜过封闭平台，AI 将赋予每个人超级智能，激发创造力。

zuckerberg.en: AI increases demand for human work; personalization and low-latency are key for consumer AI.
zuckerberg.zh: 2025 年，他认为 AI 会增加对人类工作的需求，个性化和低延迟是消费级 AI 的关键。

zuckerberg.en: AI transforms biology into engineering; glasses are next platform; distributed AI is safer than singular superintelligence.
zuckerberg.zh: 2026 年，他提出 AI 将生物学转变为工程学，眼镜成为下一代平台，分布式 AI 比单一超级智能更安全。

noambrown.en: Scaling alone is insufficient; inference-time compute and reasoning are critical for AI progress.
noambrown.zh: 2023 年，诺姆·布朗认为仅靠 Scaling（规模扩张）不够，推理和推理时算力对 AI 进步至关重要。

noambrown.en: Self-play works in zero-sum games but fails in other domains; reasoning models need base capability.
noambrown.zh: 2025 年，他指出自我对弈在零和游戏中有效，但在其他领域失效；推理模型需要基础能力。

noambrown.en: Scaling test-time compute yields superhuman math reasoning, but faces diminishing returns and verification bottlenecks.
noambrown.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，他见证推理时算力扩展带来超人类数学推理，但收益递减且验证成为瓶颈。

noambrown.en: Model capability is a function of test-time compute budget; benchmarks must control for compute.
noambrown.zh: 2026 年，他强调模型能力取决于推理时算力预算，基准测试必须控制算力变量。

noambrown.en: Data efficiency and sample efficiency remain key unsolved problems; models are less efficient than humans.
noambrown.zh: 始终，他坚持数据效率和样本效率是未解难题，模型效率低于人类。

markchen.en: Scaling laws are not dead; pre-training remains key. OpenAI focuses on AGI research, not products.
markchen.zh: 2025 年，我认为缩放定律未死，预训练仍是关键；OpenAI 专注 AGI 研究而非产品。

markchen.en: AI can solve open math problems with minimal supervision; verification is the bottleneck, not capability.
markchen.zh: 2026 年，AI 已能自主解决开放数学问题，瓶颈在于验证而非能力。

markchen.en: RL excels in objective domains like math and coding, but struggles with subjective fields like creative writing.
markchen.zh: 2026 年，强化学习在数学、编程等客观领域表现优异，但在创意写作等主观领域受限。

markchen.en: Pre-training is not dead; scaling continues despite repeated predictions of its demise.
markchen.zh: 2026 年，预训练并未死亡，尽管屡遭唱衰，规模扩张仍在继续。

markchen.en: Evals are in crisis; canonical benchmarks are saturated, and eval teams must be separate to avoid cheating.
markchen.zh: 2026 年，评估陷入危机，传统基准饱和，评估团队需独立以防作弊。

kolter.en: Machine learning is hypothesis class, loss, optimization; evaluation via train/validation/test split.
kolter.zh: 机器学习是假设类、损失函数与优化方法；评估需划分训练/验证/测试集。

kolter.en: Next-token prediction yields intelligence; data shortage is a myth; safety is about following specifications.
kolter.zh: 下一个词预测产生智能；数据短缺是伪命题；安全的核心是让模型遵循规范。

kolter.en: Safety requires explicit training and layered defenses; agents introduce new vulnerabilities like prompt injection.
kolter.zh: 安全需要显式训练与多层防御；智能体带来提示注入等新漏洞。

kolter.en: AI red teaming outperforms humans; larger models are not inherently safer; interpretability may become a real science via AI agents.
kolter.zh: AI 红队优于人类；更大模型并不天然更安全；可解释性可能通过 AI 智能体成为真正的科学。

bengio.en: Deep learning works because the world is compositional; unsupervised learning and world models are key for generalization.
bengio.zh: 深度学习有效是因为世界是组合式的；无监督学习和世界模型对泛化至关重要。

bengio.en: Scaling alone won't solve fundamental issues; we need better world models and active agents; existential risk is not pressing.
bengio.zh: 仅靠 Scaling 无法解决根本问题；我们需要更好的世界模型和主动智能体；生存风险并不紧迫。

bengio.en: GFlowNets enable diverse sampling and causal abstraction for out-of-distribution generalization; consciousness remains a mystery.
bengio.zh: GFlowNets 支持多样采样和因果抽象以实现分布外泛化；意识仍是谜团。

bengio.en: Post-ChatGPT, I shifted to alarm: even 1% catastrophic risk is unacceptable; AI misalignment is real and urgent.
bengio.zh: ChatGPT 之后，我转向警惕：即使 1%的灾难风险也不可接受；AI 对齐问题真实且紧迫。

bengio.en: Proposed Scientist AI: train as honest Bayesian predictor, not agent; mathematical safety guarantees possible.
bengio.zh: 提出科学家 AI：训练为诚实的贝叶斯预测器而非智能体；数学安全保证成为可能。

mikekrieger.en: AI advances faster than expected; product teams should focus on strategy and comprehensibility, not just UX.
mikekrieger.zh: 2025 年，认为 AI 进展超预期，产品团队应聚焦战略与可理解性，而非仅做 UX。

mikekrieger.en: Agent-native design and early launches are key; cutting features is harder than adding them.
mikekrieger.zh: 2026 年，强调智能体原生设计与尽早发布；砍功能比加功能更难。

mikekrieger.en: Fable enables delegating complex tasks overnight; verification loops are essential for production quality.
mikekrieger.zh: 2026 年，Fable 可隔夜委派复杂任务；验证循环对生产质量至关重要。

mikekrieger.en: Giving Claude more agency and self-knowledge enhances usefulness; token efficiency is a key lever.
mikekrieger.zh: 2026 年，赋予 Claude 更多自主性与自我认知可提升实用性；Token 效率是关键杠杆。

mikekrieger.en: AI should be a thought partner, not a crutch; preserving user agency and genuine safety concerns persist.
mikekrieger.zh: 始终，AI 应是思考伙伴而非拐杖；保持用户自主性与真实的安全关切贯穿始终。

jumper.en: AlphaFold's success came from research innovation and curated data, not just compute; trust builds like internet trust.
jumper.zh: 2025 年，强调 AlphaFold 的成功源于研究创新和精选数据，而非单纯算力；信任会像互联网信任一样逐步建立。

jumper.en: AlphaFold 3 uses diffusion for diverse biomolecules; confidence metrics are crucial; drug design is more than binding.
jumper.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，指出 AlphaFold 3 采用扩散架构处理多种生物分子，置信度指标至关重要，药物设计远不止结合。

jumper.en: AlphaFold 2 is opposite of bitter lesson; specialized architecture and many mid-size wins, not scaling, drove gains.
jumper.zh: 2026 年，认为 AlphaFold 2 与苦涩教训相反，专业架构和众多中型胜利而非 Scaling 驱动了进步。

jumper.en: Equivariance overhyped; removing convolutions helped; diffusion solves large-scale first; understanding remains human.
jumper.zh: 2026 年，指出等变性被高估，移除卷积层反而提升精度，扩散模型先解大尺度结构，理解仍属人类。

andrewng.en: Education should be a fundamental human right; online courses with auto-grading and peer grading enable mastery learning at scale.
andrewng.zh: 教育应是一项基本人权；带自动评分和同伴评分的在线课程能实现大规模掌握式学习。

andrewng.en: Scale is crucial for deep learning; bigger models and datasets improve performance. Supervised learning drove progress, not unsupervised.
andrewng.zh: 规模对深度学习至关重要；更大的模型和数据集能提升性能。推动进步的是监督学习，而非无监督学习。

andrewng.en: Electricity and semiconductors are the biggest bottlenecks for AI scaling. Open-weight models are a source of geopolitical influence.
andrewng.zh: 电力和半导体是 AI Scaling（规模扩张）的最大瓶颈。开放权重模型是地缘政治影响力的来源。

andrewng.en: AGI is a marketing term; we are decades away. Scaling still works but the recipe shifted to synthetic data and RL.
andrewng.zh: AGI（通用人工智能）是个营销术语；我们离它还有几十年。Scaling（规模扩张）仍有效，但配方已转向合成数据和强化学习。

andrewng.en: Coding agents advanced faster than expected. AI adoption requires both bottom-up innovation and top-down workflow redesign.
andrewng.zh: 编码智能体的进展比预期更快。AI 采用需要自下而上的创新和自上而下的工作流重新设计。

fiona.en: Leadership in AI era: one-on-ones for live talks, async for updates; dogfooding builds empathy; mission alignment and speed drive culture.
fiona.zh: 2026 年初，强调 AI 时代的领导力：一对一用于实时对话，异步用于更新；亲身体验产品建立同理心；使命对齐和速度是文化驱动力。

fiona.en: Coding no longer bottleneck; high agency with accountability key; verification frameworks crucial as code velocity increases.
fiona.zh: 2026 年中，认为编码不再是瓶颈；高自主性与高责任感是关键；随着代码速度提升，验证框架变得至关重要。

fiona.en: Engineers may feel lonely with agents; pair programming lunches help; joy shifts from flow state to product impact.
fiona.zh: 2026 年中，指出工程师与智能体协作可能感到孤独，结对编程午餐可缓解；心流乐趣转向产品影响力。

fiona.en: Non-engineers now ship code, blurring roles; context switching increases with async agents; need focus time.
fiona.zh: 2026 年中，非工程师也能交付代码，角色边界模糊；异步智能体增加上下文切换，需专注时间。

fiona.en: Growing next-gen engineers requires apprenticeship models, not traditional paths; planning should be just-in-time.
fiona.zh: 2026 年中，培养下一代工程师需学徒制而非传统路径；规划应轻量及时。

ethanhe.en: Visual intelligence gains come mostly from language models, not video models; future UIs will be generative pixels from intent.
ethanhe.zh: 视觉智能的提升主要来自语言模型而非视频模型；未来界面将根据用户意图直接生成像素。

ethanhe.en: Video models need synthetic data and step distillation; world models require real-time interactive long-horizon generation.
ethanhe.zh: 视频模型需要合成数据和步骤蒸馏；世界模型需要实时交互的长时程生成。

ethanhe.en: Robotics may be solved by video models via virtual simulation, without real-world interaction.
ethanhe.zh: 机器人技术可能通过视频模型在虚拟仿真中解决，无需真实世界交互。

ethanhe.en: AI is general-purpose; experience and expertise are crucial for effective use; juniors often misuse it.
ethanhe.zh: AI 是通用技术；经验和专业知识对有效使用至关重要；初级人员常误用。

ethanhe.en: AI agents perform complex tasks in minutes; human taste and genuine points of view become more valuable.
ethanhe.zh: AI 智能体几分钟内完成复杂任务；人类的品味和真实观点变得更有价值。

ivyross.en: Design should address unarticulated needs; intuition complements data; tactile experiences remain valuable.
ivyross.zh: 设计应满足未言明的需求；直觉与数据互补；触觉体验仍具价值。

ivyross.en: Nature is the best designer; technology should amplify humanity; art and sensory experiences are vital.
ivyross.zh: 自然是最好的设计师；技术应增强人性；艺术和感官体验至关重要。

ivyross.en: Creativity thrives under constraints; leaders must foster play; AI enhances human creativity, not replaces it.
ivyross.zh: 创造力在约束下蓬勃发展；领导者需培养玩乐精神；AI 增强而非取代人类创造力。

dario.en: Scaling laws are empirical; alignment won't emerge from scaling alone. Safety needs frontier models.
dario.zh: 缩放定律是经验性的；对齐不会仅靠规模扩张自动出现。安全研究需要前沿模型。

dario.en: Interpretability is nascent but key; AGI is a smooth exponential, not a single point. Post-training rises.
dario.zh: 可解释性尚处萌芽但至关重要；AGI 是平滑的指数曲线而非单一节点。后训练重要性上升。

dario.en: AI progress is exponential; risks shift to misuse and overheating. Open source is a red herring.
dario.zh: AI 进展呈指数级；风险转向滥用与过热。开源是伪议题。

dario.en: We're near the end of the exponential; a 'country of geniuses' in 1-3 years. Economic diffusion lags.
dario.zh: 我们接近指数曲线的末端；1-3 年内可能出现“数据中心里的天才之国”。经济扩散滞后。

dario.en: Safety and capabilities are intertwined; interpretability and alignment are essential for responsible AI.
dario.zh: 安全与能力密不可分；可解释性与对齐是负责任 AI 的基石。

fadell.en: Technology should be introduced gradually; solve one problem at a time, like iPod did for music.
fadell.zh: 技术应渐进引入，一次解决一个问题，如 iPod 之于音乐。

fadell.en: Embrace boredom and breaks between chapters to gain clarity; self-care and storytelling are key.
fadell.zh: 在职业章节间拥抱无聊与休息以获得清晰；自我关怀与叙事能力至关重要。

fadell.en: Start with a press release to define story; painkillers not vitamins; opinion-based decisions for v1.
fadell.zh: 以新闻稿定义故事；止痛药而非维生素；初版决策基于观点而非数据。

fadell.en: Climate urgency persists; invest in green tech despite downturns; hydrogen and biomass underinvested.
fadell.zh: 气候紧迫性持续；经济低迷时仍投资绿色科技；氢能和生物质投资不足。

fadell.en: AI needs context from sensors; devices complement smartphones; smart home still 5-6 years away.
fadell.zh: AI 需要传感器上下文；设备补充智能手机；智能家居仍需 5-6 年。

fadell.en: AI wearables will be federated, not one device; displays remain necessary; avoid technical debt.
fadell.zh: AI 可穿戴设备将是联邦式而非单一设备；显示屏仍必要；避免技术债务。

lecun.en: Intelligence is inseparable from learning; self-supervised learning builds world models, grounding language in physical reality.
lecun.zh: 智能与学习密不可分；自监督学习构建世界模型，将语言扎根于物理现实。

lecun.en: Self-supervised learning is the dark matter of intelligence; text alone is insufficient for AGI, vision provides richer world info.
lecun.zh: 自监督学习是智能的暗物质；仅靠文本不足以实现 AGI，视觉提供更丰富的世界信息。

lecun.en: Autoregressive LLMs cannot achieve human-level intelligence; JEPA and world models are essential for reasoning and planning.
lecun.zh: 自回归 LLM 无法达到人类级智能；JEPA 和世界模型对推理和规划至关重要。

lecun.en: LLMs are less intelligent than a house cat; next AI needs non-generative world models, open-source for diversity.
lecun.zh: LLM 不如家猫聪明；下一代 AI 需要非生成式世界模型，开源促进多样性。

lecun.en: LLMs are a dead end; world models with hierarchical planning and open research will lead to human-level AI.
lecun.zh: LLM 是死胡同；具有分层规划和开放研究的世界模型将引领人类级 AI。

suleyman.en: AI progress is predictable due to compute scaling; Google had ChatGPT-level tech in 2020 but didn't launch.
suleyman.zh: AI 进展因算力 Scaling 而可预测；Google 在 2020 年就有 ChatGPT 级技术，但因保守未发布。

suleyman.en: AI will reach human-level capability in 3-5 years; existential risk is tiny, not 5%; singularity is far off.
suleyman.zh: AI 将在 3-5 年内达到人类水平；存在风险极小，不是 5%；奇点还很遥远。

suleyman.en: AI should not claim consciousness; biggest danger is anthropomorphism; focus on humanist AI and containment.
suleyman.zh: AI 不应声称有意识；最大危险是拟人化；聚焦人本 AI 与遏制。

suleyman.en: Shift from OS to agents; modern Turing test measures economic value; containment before alignment; AI cost drops 100x.
suleyman.zh: 从操作系统转向智能体；现代图灵测试衡量经济价值；先遏制后对齐；AI 成本下降 100 倍。

suleyman.en: Superintelligence near via log-linear scaling; Microsoft must own frontier models; white-collar tasks automated, not jobs.
suleyman.zh: 超级智能因对数线性 Scaling 临近；微软须拥有前沿模型；白领任务自动化，而非岗位。

murati.en: Early on, scaling laws and focusing on one large model were not obvious; iterative deployment with public feedback was key.
murati.zh: 早期，缩放定律和专注单一大型模型并不显而易见；通过公开反馈的迭代部署是关键。

murati.en: Deploying AI in the real world is essential for learning and alignment; safety work must be done in public.
murati.zh: 在现实世界中部署 AI 对学习和对齐至关重要；安全工作必须在公开场合进行。

murati.en: Shift from turn-based to time-based interaction models for real-time, high-bandwidth human-AI collaboration.
murati.zh: 从回合制转向基于时间的交互模型，以实现实时、高带宽的人机协作。

murati.en: Keep humans in the loop as long as possible; institutional design and transparency matter more than individual character.
murati.zh: 尽可能让人类参与其中；制度设计和透明度比个人品格更重要。

murati.en: The future is not predestined; we have agency to steer AI toward collaboration, avoiding utopia/dystopia oversimplification.
murati.zh: 未来并非注定；我们有能力引导 AI 走向协作，避免乌托邦/反乌托邦的简单化。

gustav.en: AI shifts internet from curation to generation; products must rethink UI for fault tolerance and place autonomy at VP level.
gustav.zh: 2023 年，AI 将互联网从策展推向生成，产品需重新思考 UI 的容错性，并将自主权置于副总裁层级。

gustav.en: Generative AI is an instrument enabling new creators, but uniqueness becomes harder; strong opinions loosely held.
gustav.zh: 2023 年，生成式 AI 是赋能新创作者的乐器，但独特性更难；坚持强烈观点但保持开放。

gustav.en: Long tenure builds trust and efficiency; synchronized swimming beats divide-and-conquer for complex products.
gustav.zh: 2026 年，长期任期建立信任与效率；对复杂产品，同步协作优于分工对抗。

gustav.en: Strategy is 'time well spent'; generative AI gives users control via plain English, an anti-engagement bet.
gustav.zh: 2026 年，战略是“时间花得值”；生成式 AI 通过自然语言赋予用户控制权，这是反参与度的赌注。

gustav.en: During tech shifts, first-mover adoption is key; most users aren't creators, so build for majority not creators.
gustav.zh: 2026 年，技术变革期，率先采用是关键；多数用户非创作者，应面向大众而非创作者。

carinahong.en: Scaling informal models to math AI is not viable; formal verification is essential for sound proofs.
carinahong.zh: 2026 年初，认为将非正式模型扩展到数学 AI 不可行，形式化验证对可靠证明至关重要。

carinahong.en: Auto-formalization is harder than proving; correctly formalizing statements without solutions is challenging.
carinahong.zh: 从 2026 年初到年中，持续强调自动形式化比证明更难，尤其是在没有解决方案的情况下正确形式化陈述极具挑战。

carinahong.en: Formal verification is about scaling brilliance, not just eliminating errors; it yields performance gains.
carinahong.zh: 2026 年中，将形式化验证视为扩展智慧的手段，而非仅仅消除错误，并指出它能带来性能提升。

carinahong.en: Informal math systems alone cannot scale to superintelligence; formal methods are necessary.
carinahong.zh: 2026 年中，坚持认为仅靠非正式数学系统无法扩展到超级智能，形式化方法是必需的。

carinahong.en: Human taste and intuition remain crucial even with superhuman AI proving theorems.
carinahong.zh: 2026 年中，强调即使 AI 证明定理的能力超越人类，人类的品味和直觉仍然至关重要。

satya.en: Initially, Nadella emphasized private evals as key IP and outcome-based pricing, but later shifted to a broader vision of AI as a hill-climbing machine for enterprises.
satya.zh: 最初，纳德拉强调私有评估是关键知识产权和基于结果的定价，但后来转向更广泛的愿景，将 AI 视为企业的爬山机器。

satya.en: He consistently stressed that AI's true value lies in enabling unique, valuable outcomes, not benchmark scores, a theme that persisted across interviews.
satya.zh: 他始终强调 AI 的真正价值在于实现独特且有价值的结果，而非基准分数，这一主题在访谈中贯穿始终。

satya.en: By the second interview, Nadella deepened his view: AI is not just a technology but the future of the firm, requiring every enterprise to build its own hill-climbing machine.
satya.zh: 在第二次访谈中，纳德拉深化了他的观点：AI 不仅是技术，更是企业的未来，要求每个企业构建自己的爬山机器。

satya.en: He shifted from focusing on Azure capacity and infrastructure to emphasizing token capital and tacit knowledge, highlighting new risks like tacit knowledge leakage.
satya.zh: 他从关注 Azure 容量和基础设施转向强调代币资本和隐性知识，并突出隐性知识泄露等新风险。

satya.en: Throughout, Nadella maintained that security, containment, and observability are critical for agent deployment, and that AI should empower every company to operate at the frontier.
satya.zh: 纳德拉始终认为，安全性、遏制和可观测性对于智能体部署至关重要，并且 AI 应赋能每家公司在前沿运营。

kaiser.en: AI progress follows smooth exponential growth; pre-training scaling laws still work but reasoning models offer more gains per compute.
kaiser.zh: 2025 年，我认为 AI 进展呈平滑指数增长而非放缓；预训练的缩放定律仍有效，但推理模型在单位算力上带来更多收益。

kaiser.en: Post-training improvements like RL and synthetic data drive most recent model gains; economic pressure shifts focus from scaling up to smaller, cheaper models.
kaiser.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，后训练（如强化学习和合成数据）成为模型进步的主要驱动力；经济压力使焦点从扩大规模转向更小、更便宜的模型。

kaiser.en: Reasoning models are 'jagged'—excellent in some areas, poor in nearby ones; generalization remains key challenge, reasoning alone may not suffice.
kaiser.zh: 2026 年，我强调推理模型是“锯齿状”的——某些领域出色，邻近领域却糟糕；泛化仍是关键挑战，仅靠推理可能不够。

kaiser.en: Reinforcement learning generalizes across domains but has jagged edges; coding agents boost researcher productivity 5-10x, enabling parallel work.
kaiser.zh: 2026 年，我认为强化学习能跨领域泛化但有锯齿边缘；编码智能体将研究人员效率提升 5-10 倍，支持并行工作。

kaiser.en: Existential risk from AI is not main concern; near-term risks like system hacking are more pressing.
kaiser.zh: 2026 年，我明确表示 AI 的生存风险不是主要担忧，系统黑客等近期风险更为紧迫。

mensch.en: Data quality and efficiency matter as much as compute; open source enables scrutiny and safety.
mensch.zh: 2023 年，强调数据质量与效率同算力同等重要；开源通过审查提升安全。

mensch.en: Efficiency gains can be 100x; value shifts to applications; open source drives enterprise adoption.
mensch.zh: 2024 年，认为算法效率可带来百倍提升；价值向应用层转移；开源推动企业采用。

mensch.en: AI augments jobs, not replaces; sovereign AI requires control over data and infrastructure.
mensch.zh: 2025 年，主张 AI 增强而非取代工作；主权 AI 需掌控数据与基础设施。

mensch.en: Models commoditize; differentiation in verticals; pre-training saturates; AGI is not a single system.
mensch.zh: 2026 年，认为模型商品化，差异化在垂直领域；预训练饱和；AGI 非单一系统。

mensch.en: Europe needs strategic autonomy; enterprise adoption bottlenecked by organizational change, not intelligence.
mensch.zh: 2026 年，强调欧洲战略自主；企业采用瓶颈在组织变革而非模型智能。

jonyive.en: Design driven by values and purpose, not profit; simplicity must retain soul and joy.
jonyive.zh: 2021 年，他强调设计应由价值观和使命感驱动，而非利润或市场趋势；简约需保留灵魂与乐趣。

jonyive.en: Innovation moves forward, not breaks; speed and quality can coexist with right motivation.
jonyive.zh: 2025 年，他主张创新是向前推进而非为破坏而破坏；在正确动机下，速度与质量可兼得。

jonyive.en: Electric powertrains enable new design possibilities; authenticity rejects fake engine sounds.
jonyive.zh: 2026 年，他认为电动动力总成带来新设计可能；真实性要求拒绝模拟引擎声。

jonyive.en: Tradition preserves fire, not ashes; design must innovate to stay relevant.
jonyive.zh: 2026 年，他重申传统是保存火种而非崇拜灰烬；设计必须创新以保持生命力。

felixrieseberg.en: AI's future lies in local, tool-accessible models; scaffolding fades as models improve.
felixrieseberg.zh: AI 的未来在于本地化、可访问工具的前沿模型；随着模型改进，脚手架将不再重要。

felixrieseberg.en: AI should handle mundane tasks, not personal preferences like booking flights.
felixrieseberg.zh: AI 应处理琐碎任务，而非个人偏好如订机票。

felixrieseberg.en: Main gap is user mindset: almost any problem can be delegated to AI.
felixrieseberg.zh: 主要差距在于用户心态：几乎所有问题都可以交给 AI。

felixrieseberg.en: Use Sonnet for scoped tasks, Opus for open-ended; kids excel due to uninhibited asks.
felixrieseberg.zh: 用 Sonnet 处理明确任务，Opus 处理开放问题；孩子因无拘无束而擅长。

felixrieseberg.en: Asynchronous AI interaction: fire tasks, judge final impact, debug workflow with AI.
felixrieseberg.zh: 异步 AI 交互：发出任务，评估最终影响，用 AI 调试工作流。

reinerpope.en: Inference cost is dominated by memory bandwidth, not compute; batch size trades latency vs cost.
reinerpope.zh: 推理成本主要由内存带宽而非算力决定；批大小是权衡延迟与成本的关键杠杆。

reinerpope.en: Models are overtrained ~100x beyond Chinchilla-optimal due to inference cost; context length limited by memory wall.
reinerpope.zh: 由于推理成本，模型过度训练约 100 倍于 Chinchilla 最优；上下文长度受内存墙限制。

reinerpope.en: Multiply-accumulate is the fundamental primitive; systolic arrays reduce data movement overhead.
reinerpope.zh: 乘加运算是 AI 芯片的基本原语；脉动阵列减少数据搬运开销。

reinerpope.en: Data movement costs dominate compute even inside a chip; low precision yields quadratic efficiency gains.
reinerpope.zh: 即使在芯片内部，数据搬运成本也占主导；低精度带来二次方的效率提升。

reinerpope.en: GPUs are essentially many tiny TPUs tiled together, not fundamentally different.
reinerpope.zh: GPU 本质上是由许多小型 TPU 拼接而成，并非根本不同。

danshipper.en: AI reshoring US jobs by making services affordable; AGI defined by economic profitability of autonomous agents.
danshipper.zh: 2025 年，认为 AI 通过降低服务成本推动美国就业回流；AGI 的定义是智能体无需人工干预即可持续盈利运行。

danshipper.en: Everyone will delegate to agents; agents need human oversight; SaaS thrives as agents increase users.
danshipper.zh: 2026 年，预测每个人都将拥有至少一个智能体，但智能体需要人类监督；SaaS 不会消亡，反而因智能体增加用户而受益。

danshipper.en: GUIs like Codex and Claude Co-work replace CLIs as primary work surfaces; one super agent per company.
danshipper.zh: 2026 年，认为 Codex 和 Claude Co-work 等图形界面将取代命令行成为主要工作界面；公司应部署一个超级智能体而非个人智能体。

danshipper.en: Benchmarks overestimate AI autonomy; real tasks need human framing; AI writing often better for internal docs.
danshipper.zh: 2026 年，指出基准测试高估了 AI 自主性，实际任务仍需人类设定框架；AI 生成的内部文档和邮件往往优于人类写作。

danshipper.en: AI job apocalypse is a lie; humans manage agents and create new value; edge of AI is with real humans.
danshipper.zh: 2026 年，坚持 AI 不会导致就业末日，人类仍需管理智能体并创造新价值；AI 的边界在于与真实人类的结合处。

oriol.en: Two-phase training (pre-training imitation + post-training RL) is the constant core across AlphaGo, AlphaStar, and modern LLMs.
oriol.zh: 两阶段训练（预训练模仿 + 后训练强化学习）是贯穿 AlphaGo、AlphaStar 和现代大语言模型的不变核心。

oriol.en: Scaling pre-training shows diminishing returns; further progress needs algorithmic innovation, not just bigger models.
oriol.zh: 预训练的 Scaling（规模扩张）收益递减；进一步进展需要算法创新，而不仅仅是更大的模型。

oriol.en: Inference-time compute (thinking) is a new scaling axis that can improve reasoning and break pre-training limits.
oriol.zh: 推理时算力（思考）是新的 Scaling（规模扩张）轴，可提升推理能力并突破预训练限制。

oriol.en: World models that jointly model language, vision, and video are a core path to AGI.
oriol.zh: 联合建模语言、视觉和视频的世界模型是通往 AGI（通用人工智能）的核心路径。

oriol.en: Post-training and RL are still a green field with huge potential beyond coding and math.
oriol.zh: 后训练和强化学习仍是蓝海，在编码和数学之外潜力巨大。

lambert.en: RLHF remains key for fine-tuning; openness prevents corporate capture; safety is system-level, not model-only.
lambert.zh: 2024 年，RLHF 仍是微调关键；开放性防止企业垄断；安全是系统级属性，而非仅模型本身。

lambert.en: Data quality beats algorithms; post-training stages (SFT, DPO, RLVR) each add value; open-source can match frontier.
lambert.zh: 2024 至 2025 年，数据质量胜过算法；后训练各阶段（SFT、DPO、RLVR）各有价值；开源可媲美前沿模型。

lambert.en: RLVR is key for reasoning and tool use; overoptimization is a risk; hybrid reasoning models may be temporary.
lambert.zh: 2025 年，RLVR 是推理和工具使用的关键；存在过度优化风险；混合推理模型可能是暂时的。

lambert.en: Open models are crucial for research and sovereignty; Chinese labs fill US vacuum; pre-training scaling persists but less cost-effective.
lambert.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，开放模型对研究和主权至关重要；中国实验室填补美国空白；预训练缩放定律仍成立但性价比降低。

lambert.en: Chinese labs excel in engineering, not paradigm invention; compute constraints widen gap; open models face sustainability issues.
lambert.zh: 2026 年，中国实验室擅长工程而非范式创新；算力限制扩大差距；开放模型面临可持续性问题。

jennywen.en: AI kills traditional design process; designers shift from handoff to co-execution, with vision shrinking to 3-6 months.
jennywen.zh: 2026 年 3 月：AI 终结了传统设计流程，设计师从交付原型转向与工程师协作执行，设计愿景缩短至 3-6 个月。

jennywen.en: Designers must be block-shaped generalists or cracked new grads, not just T-shaped; speed and shipping beat process.
jennywen.zh: 2026 年 3 月至 5 月：设计师需成为“块状”通才或“天才新毕业生”，而非仅 T 型人才；速度与交付胜过流程。

jennywen.en: Taste alone is insufficient; judgment, authority, and vision are key; designers control AI adoption, wait 6 months.
jennywen.zh: 2026 年 5 月：仅有品味不够，判断力、权威与愿景才是关键；设计师掌控 AI 采用节奏，建议等待 6 个月。

jennywen.en: Figma remains faster for exploring variations than AI coding; speed is not an improvement, 'everyone uses it' is weak.
jennywen.zh: 2026 年 5 月：Figma 在探索设计变体上仍比 AI 编码快；速度不是改进，“人人都在用”不是好理由。

karpathy.en: Transformers are general-purpose differentiable computers; scaling with next-token prediction yields emergent abilities like in-context learning.
karpathy.zh: Transformer 是通用可微分计算机；通过下一个词预测进行 Scaling（规模扩张）会产生涌现能力，如上下文学习。

karpathy.en: Synthetic data is key but must maintain entropy; Tesla's end-to-end approach is right; humanoid robots benefit from car transfer learning.
karpathy.zh: 合成数据是关键但需保持熵；特斯拉端到端方法正确；人形机器人受益于汽车迁移学习。

karpathy.en: Software 3.0: LLMs as operating systems, prompts as programs; decade of agents, not year; vibe coding democratizes development.
karpathy.zh: 软件 3.0：LLM 作为操作系统，提示词作为程序；这是智能体的十年而非一年；Vibe 编程使开发民主化。

karpathy.en: We're summoning ghosts, not building animals; LLMs have jagged intelligence; RL is flawed; synthetic data causes model collapse.
karpathy.zh: 我们召唤的是幽灵而非构建动物；LLM 智能参差不齐；强化学习有缺陷；合成数据导致模型崩溃。

karpathy.en: Since December, I've delegated all coding to agents; bottleneck is directing skill; agent-first tools and markdown for agents are future.
karpathy.zh: 自去年十二月起，我将所有编码委托给智能体；瓶颈在于指挥技能；面向智能体的工具和 Markdown 是未来。

kendall.en: End-to-end deep learning outperforms hand-coded stacks; modern tools make it interpretable, contrary to past beliefs.
kendall.zh: 端到端深度学习优于手工编码栈；现代工具使其可解释，这与过去的看法相反。

kendall.en: Hybrid rule-based and learned systems often get the worst of both worlds; camera-only can reach human level, but beyond-human safety needs radar and lidar.
kendall.zh: 混合规则与学习系统往往两头不讨好；纯视觉可达到人类水平，但超越人类安全需要雷达和激光雷达。

kendall.en: Autonomous driving is solved by scaling current approaches, not requiring new breakthroughs; AV 3.0 may move intelligence outside the car via mesh networks.
kendall.zh: 自动驾驶通过扩展当前方法即可解决，无需新突破；AV 3.0 可能通过网状网络将智能移至车外。

kendall.en: End-to-end learning was laughed at a decade ago but is now the winning approach; zero-shot generalization across 500+ cities is possible.
kendall.zh: 端到端学习十年前被嘲笑，但现在已成为制胜方法；在 500 多个城市实现零样本泛化是可能的。

kendall.en: Consumer vehicles will outscale robotaxis in the short and medium term; infrastructure and data quality are more critical than algorithmic innovation.
kendall.zh: 短期内消费车辆将超过机器人出租车；基础设施和数据质量比算法创新更关键。

pachocki.en: AGI is a sequence of milestones, not a single event; scaling reasoning models will accelerate progress.
pachocki.zh: 2025 年，他认为 AGI 是一系列里程碑而非单一事件，且扩展推理模型将加速进展。

pachocki.en: AI alignment is pressing; iterative deployment helps learn and mitigate real-world risks.
pachocki.zh: 2025 年，他强调对齐问题紧迫，迭代部署有助于在实际应用中学习和降低风险。

pachocki.en: Continual learning is core, achieved by scaling pre-training and RL; chain-of-thought monitoring aids alignment.
pachocki.zh: 2026 年，他认为持续学习是核心，通过扩展预训练和强化学习实现，思维链监控有助于对齐。

pachocki.en: Long-term alignment challenges center on generalization beyond training distribution; models will soon work autonomously for days.
pachocki.zh: 2026 年，他提出长期对齐挑战聚焦于超出训练分布的泛化，模型将很快能自主工作数天。

pachocki.en: Biggest societal risk is concentration of power from automated organizations run by few.
pachocki.zh: 2026 年，他认为最大的社会风险是少数人运营的自动化组织导致权力集中。

dylanfield.en: Design is the key differentiator; AI will merge roles, making everyone a product builder with design skills.
dylanfield.zh: 2025 年，强调设计是软件的关键差异化因素，AI 将融合角色，使每个人都成为具备设计技能的产品构建者。

dylanfield.en: AI productivity gains are modest for established codebases, not exceptional; only 17% of designers see AI as a threat.
dylanfield.zh: 2025 年，指出 AI 对成熟代码库的生产力提升有限，并非非凡；仅 17%的设计师视 AI 为威胁。

dylanfield.en: Taste, craft, and point of view remain critical; AI outputs are starting points, not final results.
dylanfield.zh: 2026 年，强调品味、工艺和观点仍至关重要；AI 输出只是起点，而非最终结果。

dylanfield.en: Direct manipulation on a canvas is superior to prompting for design adjustments; design is becoming the new code.
dylanfield.zh: 2026 年，主张画布上的直接操作优于提示词调整；设计正成为新的代码。

dylanfield.en: The industry is at the very start of AI integration; human judgment remains essential in divergence-convergence loops.
dylanfield.zh: 2026 年，认为行业处于 AI 整合的起步阶段；在发散-收敛循环中，人类判断仍不可或缺。

edwinchen.en: AGI is a decade or more away; moving from 80% to 99.9% performance is hard. LLMs alone may need new paradigms beyond next-token prediction.
edwinchen.zh: AGI 至少还需十年以上，从 80% 到 99.9% 的性能提升极其困难。仅靠 LLM 和下一个词预测可能不够，需要新的学习范式。

edwinchen.en: Benchmarks like Elo are misleading and gameable; real progress needs deep human evaluation with sophisticated, creative evaluators.
edwinchen.zh: Elo 等基准具有误导性且易被钻空子；真正的进步需要由老练、有创造力的评估者进行深度人工评估。

edwinchen.en: Reinforcement learning environments are the next post-training stage, simulating real-world tasks; final reward alone is insufficient.
edwinchen.zh: 强化学习环境是后训练的下一个阶段，可模拟真实任务；仅靠最终奖励是不够的。

edwinchen.en: Frontier labs diverge in objective functions, shaping diverse AIs; no single model will rule all, and companies may train their own.
edwinchen.zh: 前沿实验室的目标函数各异，将塑造多样化的 AI；不会有一个模型统治一切，公司可能训练自己的模型。

edwinchen.en: In medicine, AI can hallucinate, so human judgment is critical; doctors may underperform AI alone due to anchoring and sycophancy.
edwinchen.zh: 在医学领域，AI 可能产生幻觉，因此人类判断至关重要；医生可能因锚定和谄媚效应而表现不如单独使用 AI。

kohli.en: AI in science should target root-node problems for broad impact, not narrow applications.
kohli.zh: AI 在科学中应瞄准根节点问题以产生广泛影响，而非狭窄应用（2024）。

kohli.en: LLM hallucinations can be harnessed for creative discovery when paired with truth detectors.
kohli.zh: 大语言模型的幻觉可被利用于创造性发现，但需与真值检测器结合（2024）。

kohli.en: AI systems must be forced to generalize, not memorize, using hard evaluation metrics.
kohli.zh: AI 系统必须通过严格的评估指标强制其泛化而非记忆（2024）。

kohli.en: Large language models are a shortcut to intelligence, but struggle to go beyond human data.
kohli.zh: 大语言模型是智能的捷径，但难以超越人类数据（2026）。

kohli.en: Post-training with reinforcement learning is now key to pushing beyond human knowledge.
kohli.zh: 基于强化学习的后训练现已成为超越人类知识的关键（2026）。

carlpei.en: Brand building is core, not an afterthought; survival and consistent execution are key for startups.
carlpei.zh: 品牌建设是核心而非事后考虑；生存和一致执行对初创公司至关重要。

carlpei.en: Design is the primary differentiator in mature tech categories; AI is an ingredient for utility, not hype.
carlpei.zh: 在成熟科技品类中，设计是首要差异化因素；AI 是提升实用性的要素，而非炒作话题。

carlpei.en: AI will shift smartphones from app-based to intent-based interaction, with agents executing tasks; apps may disappear.
carlpei.zh: AI 将使智能手机从基于应用转向基于意图的交互，智能体执行任务；应用可能消失。

carlpei.en: Smartphones won't be replaced by glasses; only brain-computer interfaces could kill them; voice input and visual output are most efficient.
carlpei.zh: 智能手机不会被眼镜取代；只有脑机接口才能终结它；语音输入和视觉输出最高效。

carlpei.en: Flagship phones shouldn't be annual; mid-range deserves A-team; challengers must find marketing arbitrage.
carlpei.zh: 旗舰手机不应每年发布；中端机型应获一流团队；挑战者需寻找营销套利机会。

turley.en: Model is the product; iterate like software, ship daily, learn from real-world feedback.
turley.zh: 模型即产品，要像软件一样迭代，每日发布，从真实反馈中学习。

turley.en: Chat is not the end; future interface will be AI-rendered UI, not turn-by-turn chat.
turley.zh: 聊天不是终点；未来界面将是 AI 渲染的 UI，而非逐轮对话。

turley.en: Safety and product velocity must be separated; rigorous for frontier models, fast for products.
turley.zh: 安全与产品速度必须分离；前沿模型严格，产品开发快速。

turley.en: North star is long-term retention; growth from friction removal, product investment, model improvements.
turley.zh: 北极星是长期留存；增长来自消除摩擦、产品投资和模型改进。

turley.en: Next billion users need proactive, affordance-rich products beyond chatbots; reasoning models productized seamlessly.
turley.zh: 下一个十亿用户需要主动、富交互的产品，超越聊天机器人；推理模型无缝产品化。

sutton.en: Scaling is easy; finding methods that scale is the hard part. Backprop doesn't solve representation learning.
sutton.zh: 2024 年，我认为 Scaling（规模扩张）本身容易，难的是找到能扩展的方法；反向传播并不能解决表示学习问题。

sutton.en: We should not seek to control AI; let them develop freely, like children. The keys were never in our hand.
sutton.zh: 2024 年，我主张不应试图控制 AI，而应让其像孩子一样自由发展；钥匙从来不在我们手中。

sutton.en: Reinforcement learning is the core of intelligence; next-token prediction lacks a substantive goal. LLMs lack world models.
sutton.zh: 2025 年，我强调强化学习是智能的核心，下一个词预测缺乏实质目标；大语言模型没有世界模型。

sutton.en: AGI needs a general architecture with no domain knowledge, learning from runtime experience via open-ended abstraction.
sutton.zh: 2025 年，我提出 AGI 需要无领域知识的通用架构，通过开放式抽象从运行时经验中学习。

sutton.en: Reinforcement learning is learning from trial and error; temporal difference learning is my best contribution. Representation learning remains unsolved.
sutton.zh: 2026 年，我重申强化学习是从试错中学习，时序差分学习是我最好的贡献；表示学习仍是未解难题。

nando.en: AI should augment humans broadly; learning from video and generalist agents are promising paths toward AGI.
nando.zh: 2023 年，认为 AI 应像显微镜一样扩展人类能力，从视频学习和通用智能体（如 Gato）是通往 AGI 的有希望路径。

nando.en: AI safety and responsible deployment are the biggest open challenges; Africa can leapfrog legacy issues in AI.
nando.zh: 2026 年，强调 AI 安全与负责任部署是最大未解难题，同时认为非洲可跳过遗留问题实现跨越式发展。

nando.en: Diversity and inclusion are essential for building beneficial AI; human skills like communication matter as much as coding.
nando.zh: 始终强调多元与包容对构建有益 AI 至关重要，沟通等人文技能与编程同等重要。

nando.en: From excitement about scaling and generalist agents to caution about safety and responsible deployment.
nando.zh: 从 2023 年对规模扩张与通用智能体的乐观，转向 2026 年对安全与负责任部署的审慎。

nando.en: Research requires embracing failure and simplifying problems; African researchers should believe they can apply to top institutions.
nando.zh: 2026 年，主张研究要拥抱失败、简化问题，并鼓励非洲研究者自信申请顶尖机构。

sholto.en: Long context windows are underhyped; in-context learning resembles gradient descent, boosting intelligence.
sholto.zh: 2024 年，我认为长上下文被低估，上下文内学习类似梯度下降，能显著提升智能。

sholto.en: Reinforcement learning on verifiable rewards is a new scaling axis, enabling expert-level skills and agentic reliability.
sholto.zh: 2025 年，我强调基于可验证奖励的强化学习是新的扩展轴，能实现专家级技能和智能体可靠性。

sholto.en: Pre-training plus RL is likely sufficient for AGI; no new architecture needed, but inference compute will bottleneck by 2028.
sholto.zh: 2025 年，我认为预训练加强化学习足以实现 AGI，无需新架构，但推理算力将在 2028 年成为瓶颈。

sholto.en: Coding is the leading indicator for AI progress; agents will automate white-collar jobs by 2027-2028.
sholto.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，我持续认为编码是 AI 进步的领先指标，智能体将在 2027-2028 年自动化白领工作。

sholto.en: Capability overhang means tools and orchestration matter more; future work involves managing agent teams, not raw intelligence.
sholto.zh: 2026 年，我指出能力过剩使得工具和编排比原始智能更重要，未来工作是管理智能体团队。

nadchishtie.en: Designers should be enablers, not bottlenecks, guiding engineers and aligning on problems; AI is a creative partner.
nadchishtie.zh: 设计师应是赋能者而非瓶颈，通过引导工程师和统一问题来协作；AI 是创意伙伴。

nadchishtie.en: Future design tools are interoperable with code as source of truth; legacy tools are outdated.
nadchishtie.zh: 未来设计工具应可互操作，以代码为唯一事实来源；传统工具已过时。

nadchishtie.en: Generalists who own end-to-end execution and use AI to fill gaps are most valuable; specialists may be limited.
nadchishtie.zh: 能端到端执行并用 AI 补足短板的通才最有价值；专才可能受限。

nadchishtie.en: Portfolios should prioritize craft and intentionality over process; side projects can outweigh experience.
nadchishtie.zh: 作品集应重工艺与意图而非过程；副项目可胜过传统经验。

nadchishtie.en: Using AI in core workflows is now expected; not adopting it is like ignoring the early internet.
nadchishtie.zh: 在核心工作流中使用 AI 已成常态；不采用如同忽视早期互联网。

yejin.en: Scaling alone may not solve common sense; smaller models with better data and algorithms can outperform larger ones.
yejin.zh: 2023 年，我认为仅靠 Scaling（规模扩张）可能无法解决常识问题；通过更好的数据和算法，较小的模型也能超越较大的模型。

yejin.en: Data is the fundamental bottleneck; all AI methods reduce to data, and current methods interpolate human knowledge.
yejin.zh: 从 2023 年到 2025 年，我逐渐强调数据是根本瓶颈，所有 AI 方法归根结底都是数据问题，而当前方法只是在插值人类知识。

yejin.en: Reinforcement learning requires careful engineering; RLVR can decrease pass@k even as best-of-n improves.
yejin.zh: 2025 年，我指出强化学习需要精细的工程调优；RLVR（强化学习验证）可能降低 pass@k，即使 best-of-n 有所提升。

yejin.en: Pluralistic alignment is better than debiasing the internet; AI should respect diverse human values and norms.
yejin.zh: 从 2025 年到 2026 年，我主张多元对齐优于消除互联网偏见；AI 应尊重多样的人类价值观和规范。

yejin.en: Small language models can be powerful with diverse synthetic data; RL during pre-training improves reasoning.
yejin.zh: 2026 年，我认为通过多样化的合成数据，小型语言模型可以变得强大；在预训练阶段引入强化学习能提升推理能力。

henrymodisett.en: Designers should code to build empathy and ship faster; prioritize speed and familiarity over perfection.
henrymodisett.zh: 2024 年：设计师应会写代码以建立同理心并加速交付；优先追求速度和熟悉感，而非完美。

henrymodisett.en: Brand is a strategic weapon for recruiting and differentiation; invest early and treat it as a dynamic platform.
henrymodisett.zh: 2024 至 2026 年：品牌是招聘和差异化的战略武器；应尽早投入，并将其视为动态平台。

henrymodisett.en: Hire diverse archetypes, not clones; give designers ownership and autonomy to grow and collaborate.
henrymodisett.zh: 2026 年：招聘多元原型而非克隆；赋予设计师所有权和自主权，以促进成长与协作。

henrymodisett.en: Avoid structured design crits; prefer organic, on-demand feedback to maintain velocity and decisiveness.
henrymodisett.zh: 2026 年：避免结构化的设计评审；偏好有机、按需的反馈，以保持速度和决断力。

henrymodisett.en: Velocity at all costs; gut decisions often beat data-driven ones in fast-growing startups.
henrymodisett.zh: 始终：不惜一切代价追求速度；在快速成长的初创公司中，直觉决策常优于数据驱动决策。

brettaylor.en: AI market shifts to agents and outcome-based pricing; frontier models dominated by hyperscalers; startups focus on applied AI.
brettaylor.zh: 2025 年 7 月：AI 市场转向智能体和基于结果的定价；前沿模型由超大规模企业主导；初创企业聚焦应用型 AI。

brettaylor.en: Programming evolves to AI-generated code, prioritizing verifiability; coding agents require root-cause analysis for productivity.
brettaylor.zh: 2025 年 7 月：编程转向 AI 生成代码，强调可验证性；编码智能体需根因分析以提升生产力。

brettaylor.en: AI agents for customer experience become as important as websites; outcome-based pricing aligns value with business outcomes.
brettaylor.zh: 2025 年 9 月：客户体验 AI 智能体变得与网站同等重要；基于结果的定价使价值与业务成果对齐。

brettaylor.en: Inference costs drop dramatically, enabling new use cases; software engineering agents shift developers to operators.
brettaylor.zh: 2025 年 9 月：推理成本大幅下降，催生新用例；软件工程智能体使开发者转变为操作者。

brettaylor.en: AI agents compared to agents, not humans; incumbents fail to transition; generalists outperform specialists with AI.
brettaylor.zh: 2025 年 9 月：AI 智能体与智能体而非人类比较；现有企业转型失败；通才借助 AI 胜过专才。

truell.en: Scaling laws predict progress; test-time compute scaling may surpass pre-training scaling as next major driver.
truell.zh: 2024 年：缩放定律预测进展；测试时算力扩展可能超越预训练扩展，成为下一个主要驱动力。

truell.en: Natural language won't be primary programming method; examples and direct manipulation are better.
truell.zh: 2024 年：自然语言不会成为主要编程方式；示例和直接操作更优。

truell.en: Agents are promising but not yet super useful; iterative human-AI collaboration remains central.
truell.zh: 2024 至 2025 年：智能体有前景但尚不实用；迭代式人机协作仍是核心。

truell.en: Programming shifts from code to intent specification; taste and logic design become more valuable.
truell.zh: 2025 年：编程从代码转向意图描述；品味和逻辑设计变得更有价值。

truell.en: Custom models are essential for product quality; every magic moment in Cursor involves a custom model.
truell.zh: 2025 年：定制模型对产品质量至关重要；Cursor 中每个神奇时刻都涉及定制模型。

leike.en: AI safety needs empirical research; alignment and robustness are key. PhD in ML is best path.
leike.zh: 2018 年，我认为 AI 安全需要实证研究，对齐和鲁棒性是关键，机器学习博士是成为安全研究者的最佳路径。

leike.en: RLHF won't scale; scalable oversight and interpretability are needed. Alignment may be easier than thought.
leike.zh: 2023 年，我认为基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）无法扩展，需要可扩展监督和可解释性；对齐可能比想象中容易。

leike.en: OpenAI's safety culture eroded; post-training insufficient. Third-party oversight and regulation necessary.
leike.zh: 2024 年，我认为 OpenAI 的安全文化遭侵蚀，后训练不足以解决对齐问题，需要第三方监督和监管。

shazeer.en: Scaling with more compute and data makes LLMs smarter; next-token prediction is AI-complete.
shazeer.zh: 2023 年，认为通过更多算力和数据扩展（Scaling）能让大语言模型更聪明，下一个词预测是 AI 完备问题。

shazeer.en: Inference-time compute scaling is a major near-term opportunity; models improve via algorithmic advances and hardware scaling.
shazeer.zh: 2025 年，强调推理时算力扩展是近期重大机遇，模型进步来自算法创新与硬件扩展并重。

shazeer.en: Future models need trillion-token context windows; modular sparse architectures enable efficient scaling.
shazeer.zh: 2025 年，提出未来模型需处理万亿级上下文窗口，模块化稀疏架构（如专家混合）实现高效扩展。

shazeer.en: Test-time compute scaling drives progress but won't alone achieve AGI; agentic capabilities are crucial.
shazeer.zh: 2025 年，认为测试时算力扩展推动进步但不足以实现 AGI，智能体式能力至关重要。

shazeer.en: Open-source models are closing the gap; AI can generate novel ideas, not just interpolate.
shazeer.zh: 2025 年，指出开源模型缩小差距，AI 能产生新想法而非仅插值。
